evidence.observation: Tube pressure has drifted monotonically upward during growth from ~2.95 to 3.159 Torr (k=20→25), far beyond the ~±0.02 Torr scatter seen in purge/ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from a flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~44-45%; thermal control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so atmosphere integrity (air ingress) cannot be verified
